description: Opt-out dengan panduan untuk Social Catfish. Seseorang mengikuti langkah-langkah pada daftar periksa; OpenOptOut menyediakan alamat email sekali pakai dan mengeklik tautan konfirmasi.
instructions: Search socialcatfish.com and note the address of every page that shows you. Buka socialcatfish.com/opt-out, scroll to the section for removing pages, emails, phone numbers and addresses, and ask only for things it already shows. Give {contact_email} as your email; Social Catfish emails a confirmation link that OpenOptOut clicks for you. Kemudian tekan "Saya sudah melakukan ini".
